excerpt: Jennifer LaFleur Adjunct Professorial Lecturer SOC Faculty Bio Jennifer LaFleur joined AU in Fall 2017 as data journalist in residence and data editor for The Investigative Reporting Workshop. Previously, she was a senior editor at Reveal from The Center for Investigative Reporting and was director of computer-assisted reporting at ProPublica. She has held similar roles at The Dallas Morning News, the San Jose Mercury News and the St. Louis Post-Dispatch. She is a former training director for Investigative Reporters and Editors and has won awards for her coverage of criminal justice, disability and transparency issues.
